full_text: Princess, come back! Those walls ain't love. Not his property, not his proof in the math. No lullaby, no silence, no locked-in end. You are free, you are free, if the dragon rise. Lift your voice, a voice, let the whole night flood. Not his property, not his prize. Take your light and rise. You are free, you are free. Come back to yourself again.
